entities.name: Imogen Stuart
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Imogen Stuart was a German-Irish sculptor, influenced by Expressionism and early Irish Christian art. She mainly produced wood and stone for settings for churches but also created many secular works, and was exhibited internationally.
